biggest_catch: Your $110 only lands after the friend holds two or more recurring direct deposits totaling $500+ for 60 days - and the reward deposits to your primary savings within 14 business days after qualification, so expect a multi-month wait.
catches: Both Advocate (referrer) and Friend must be over 18; Advocate must be a primary LMCU member in good standing with a valid email on file.
Friend must open a qualified LMCU membership with checking account using the Advocate's referral link.
Friend must hold two or more recurring direct deposits totaling $500.00 or more for 60 days.
Reward: $110 deposited to the Advocate's primary savings account and $110 to the Friend's primary savings within 14 business days after qualification.
Cap: up to $550 a year (5 referrals).
No expiry date stated on the page.

steps: Enter the email you use with your LMCU account to get your unique referral link.
Share the link with friends and family by email, text, or social media.
Friend opens a qualified LMCU membership with checking using your link and holds 2+ recurring direct deposits totaling $500+ for 60 days.
LMCU deposits $110 into your primary savings account within 14 business days (up to $550/year).
